mentl/1c2bab0:
The site-audit framing was wrong, and the correction is the whole finding.
D0's entry said ~100 genuine construction sites each needed an audit of
"where did the graph already prove this type?". Measured: it did not prove
it anywhere. The parser mints a node per EXPRESSION position — every
subexpression gets a handle — and collapses an entire TYPE expression into
ONE node holding a value tree (NTypeAnn(Ty), types.mn:1433). A source type's
interior positions have no handles because nothing ever minted them.

So D0 is one change rather than an audit: parse_type_atom mints a node per
type position and returns a handle, exactly as parse_expr already does. The
construction sites dissolve — the parser mints them where the type is
written — and inference-side constructions already mint through mint(reason).
Seven functions own the parser's type surface.

Same asymmetry as the module-blind parse one layer down: spans were
second-class until the parse entered the module. Types are the next one.
mentl/1c4d457:
Fifth tick of the 6.3 modal sweep, and the first that found a hole
instead of pinning a rule that already held.

SYNTAX gives type ReadOnly = File - write and states E - F = E & !F, so
a subtracted member is forbidden. The artifact drops it instead: with
type Both = A + B and type OnlyA = Both - B, the medium reports a fn
declared with OnlyA as carrying the positive row A, no absent member.

Nothing noticed because a direct perform still refuses —
fn direct() with OnlyA = opb() gives E_EffectMismatch: A vs B — since a
positive row does not admit B. The higher-order case leaks:
fn run(f) with OnlyA = f() applied to () => opb() is accepted, the
callback's row unifying into the open tail a positive row carries. That
is the failure §4③ names as the reason Koka omitted negation, reached
through the subtraction operator rather than through ! itself.

sound-difference-admits pins the half that holds: subtraction leaves A
admitted, higher-order included. The leak crucible is held back rather
than sitting red in the battery and lands with the fix;
row-difference-is-omission-not-negation carries the repro.

The fix is the doc's own identity: - lowers to inter_row against the
negation, so the subtracted name enters the absent field of the
canonical triple instead of leaving the present one. SYNTAX is the
authority and is not edited to match the artifact.

mentl/1c204d3:
A fast-loop micro pins it definitively: fn caller(x)=float_of_int(x)*
weight() emits i32.mul (fails to assemble) when weight is a forward-ref,
f64.mul (assembles) when weight is defined first. infer_binop's BKArith
unifies operands correctly, but infer_stmt_list walks source order
(infer.mn:211) and infer_fn generalizes per-fn (infer.mn:399), so caller
generalizes over weight()'s still-unresolved return var and it floors to
i32 at emit. The fix is Hβ.infer.scc-ordered-walk (infer callees before
callers) — a whole-program inference-order change banked for a fresh
context with two candidate implementations (topo-sort, or two-phase
infer-then-generalize) and the no-hedge constraint (never reorder the
wheel source to appease the seed). m3 assembly now stands on this one
root: 2 errors, both score_one_position. Micros in .build/probe/.

mentl/1c0dc2f:
The substrate gains nominal record declarations. Sonic Pulse's
opening lines (`type Audio = {...}`, `Spectral{centroid, ...}`)
parse and check end-to-end.

Substrate:
  RecordSchemeKind(declared_fields) — 4th SchemeKind variant. Env
    binds the type's name directly to TName (no function arrow);
    NamedRecordExpr inference reads the kind to validate field
    sets and unify against declared types.

  NamedRecordExpr(String, List) — Expr AST variant. Lowers
    identically to MakeRecordExpr; type identity is type-system-
    only, runtime sees raw fields. Same WAT layout as bare records.

Parser:
  parse_type_decl — when `=` is followed by TLBrace, parse as
    record type body. Single variant whose body is TRecord; reuse
    parse_record_type_fields + sort_record_type_fields for the
    field-sort invariant.

  postfix_loop gains TLBrace arm — capitalized identifier
    immediately followed by `{` (no whitespace separation,
    enforced by postfix_loop's call shape) → NamedRecordExpr.
    Lowercase identifiers leave the brace as a separate construct
    (block at expr position).

Inference:
  register_one_variant detects the single-variant + single-TRecord-
    field + ctor-name-matches-type-name shape; binds env to
    RecordSchemeKind instead of ConstructorScheme.

  NExpr(NamedRecordExpr) inference: env_lookup → RecordSchemeKind,
    check_nominal_record_fields walks both sorted lists pointwise:
      - missing declared field → E_RecordFieldMissing
      - extra unknown field    → E_RecordFieldExtra
      - matched name           → unify value handle against decl ty
    Binds expr handle to TName(type_name, []). tag_alloc fires for
    H4 region tracking.

  call_is_constructor → call_is_alloc_returning (renamed +
    extended). Both ConstructorScheme and RecordSchemeKind callees
    get tag_alloc on their CallExpr handles (the latter is the
    degenerate-call-form fallback; canonical is NamedRecordExpr).

Lower:
  NamedRecordExpr → LMakeRecord, identical low
